categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP1): widens _CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR_RE and _ANCHOR_COMPATIBLE_CHECKPOINT_ID_RE from CP<digits> to CP<digits> optionally followed by exactly one uppercase letter, so checkpoint_id_supports_anchor accepts the pre-2.4.0 inserted-checkpoint lettering convention (e.g. CP4B/CP6B) without widening any other checkpoint-id shape. Every docstring/comment/exception message that spelled out the old 'CP<digits>' shape as prose is updated together.

D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP1): adds a legacy-shaped fixture (the full CP1..CP9 plus CP4B/CP6B set), malformed-id fail-closed cases, a regression assertion that every 2.5.0 numeric-only-id test still passes unmodified, and a tag/shape coupling-invariant test pinning that the anchor tag grammar and the anchor id-shape grammar widen together.

D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP2): D-Plan-Amendment-4's own anchor-comment convention prose clarifies that its `<n>` placeholder denotes a checkpoint id of the widened CP<digits>[A-Z]? anchor-compatible shape, so the document and the code it describes never diverge.

D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP2): the request_plan_amendment entry-condition description and the post-anchor-coverage description under AMENDING_PLAN/plan-approval both widened from CP<digits> to CP<digits>[A-Z]?.

D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP2): /request-plan-amendment's own operator-reference Expects/Next/Refuses entries widened from CP<digits> to CP<digits>[A-Z]?, mirroring MILESTONE_WORKFLOW.md's two sites plus the command's own reference entry.
D-Checkpoint-Id-Anchor-Grammar-Widening (CP2): the command's own documented checkpoint-id-shape precondition and anchor-tag format widened from CP<digits> to CP<digits>[A-Z]?.
